purpose: Coverage plan for GNOME IBus setup and real-client integration; entries are not certification evidence.

platforms.automated_extension_runtime_compatibilit: scripts/test-gnome51-extension-runtime.sh; extension API and layout only, not desktop route certification

evidence_requirement: Every platform × application × required application scenario and every platform × lifecycle scenario requires an independently reviewed result bound to exact package, WayExpand commit, distribution release, GNOME Shell version, application/version where applicable, route, keyboard profiles, and date. Headless IBus protocol tests do not satisfy physical-session evidence. A platform remains not-tested until all required cells have evidence; no result is inferred from another toolkit, browser, package, or distro.
